menu.welcome:
🚀  Welcome, {name}!
──────────────────

📨  With this bot you can send premium emojis
in any Telegram chat!

🔖  Use the menu below:

start.invalid_set: ⚠️ The set code is invalid or has expired.
start.set_added: ✅ {count} emojis from the shared set were added to your account.

premium.title: ✨  Send Premium Emoji
premium.body:
📝  Send a new message in this chat:

⚡  Multiple premium emojis (send them all together)
or numeric codes: [5792080508976373427]

🎙  Separate multiple codes with spaces or brackets:
[code1] [code2] [code3]

🎙  Then you can choose a custom name
(or type «default»)

extract.title: 📤  Extract Premium Emoji IDs
extract.body:
🅰  Send one or more premium emojis to me:

🔷  Note: the emoji must be premium
(regular emojis have no IDs)

🎙  You can send several at once.
extract.ask_pack:
🎁  Send the premium emoji pack link:
Example: https://t.me/addemoji/PackName
extract.invalid_pack: ⚠️ That is not a valid emoji pack link. Try again or send the full addemoji/... link.
extract.empty: ⚠️ The pack is empty or invalid.
extract.chunk_error: ❌ Error while sending a result chunk: {error}

emoji.limit_reached: ⛔️ You reached the limit of {limit} emojis. Contact support to increase it.
emoji.ask_id: ✏️  Send the premium emoji you want to save (the emoji itself or a code in [brackets]):
emoji.ask_name: {alt}  Now send a custom name for this emoji (or type «default»):
emoji.invalid_id: ⚠️ No valid premium emoji or code found. Try again.

channels.body:
⌘  My channels
──────────────────

🎙  Posts containing emoji IDs in active channels
are automatically converted into premium emojis.
channels.ask_channel:
✈️  Add channel
──────────────────

📨  First make the bot an admin in your channel with these rights:

⚡ Invite users
⚡ Add admins
⚡ Edit messages

🎙  The channel must have at least 50 members.

📨  Then send the numeric ID or username of the channel:
like @my_channel or -1001234567890
channels.invalid: ⚠️ This is not a valid channel.
channels.saved:
✅ Channel «{title}» registered successfully.
From now on, [IDs] in this channel will automatically convert to premium emojis.

help.body:
❓  Bot guide
──────────────────

1️⃣ To send premium emojis in other chats, use inline mode:
@your_bot text [emoji_id]

2️⃣ To extract all IDs from an emoji pack, send the pack link to the bot.

3️⃣ In «My emojis» you can save your frequently used premium emojis.

4️⃣ After adding a channel, posts containing IDs are converted automatically.

support.body:
💎  Support
──────────────────

📨  Choose one of these ways to contact support:

⚡ Support chat:
Send your message here and support will reply through the bot

🕐 Ticket:
Register your message and support will review it
support.ask_chat: 📨 Write your message here; it will be forwarded to support through the bot:
support.ask_ticket: 🖼 Write your ticket text to register it:
support.sent: ✅ Your message has been sent to support. Please wait for a reply.
support.ticket_saved: ✅ Your ticket has been registered. It will be reviewed soon.
support.reply_failed: ❌ Not sent (user blocked the bot or is unavailable).

admin.denied: ⛔️ You do not have access to this section.
admin.ask_unlimit: 🔓 Send the numeric ID of the user whose limit you want to remove:
admin.invalid_user_id: ⚠️ Please send a valid numeric ID.
admin.user_unlimited: 🎉 Your emoji limit has been removed by an admin and you are now unlimited.
admin.ask_broadcast: 📢 Send the broadcast message to be delivered to all users:
